0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East) are looking to bounce back from a loss in their fifth game of the season, while the Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 1 game back) also dropped their most recent game. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall, and Indiana is without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, with Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard and Obi Toppin listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10.
